title: Chapter 583
paragraphs: Chapter 583
Episode 151. Situation summary (3)
Lokia Ganesto.
A knight of the 10th century and a character who was the most skilled in the old Runcandel with pure magic alone.
Jin and Valeria had seen her in the recorded video left in the fourth tomb of Temar.
"…It's surprising that it's the core part of the teleportation device, Ganesto?"
It's not a common surname. At least Jin had never met a person with the surname Ganesto, including his past and present lives.
Due to the historical manipulation of the Knights of the Ten, it was likely that people stopped using the name Ganesto.
"Tinggen Bower, Qwaul Ganesto is likely a descendant of Lokia Ganesto. I felt a resistance from historical manipulation while looking at the records."
Several assumptions quickly came to Jin's mind. All of them were not good.

Lokia Ganesto betrayed old Runcandel and her descendants have been contributing to Gipl using pseudonyms, or they were subordinated to Gipl because they forgot the grudges due to the erased history, or Gipl told her descendants wrong history and so on.
'Lokia Ganesto in the recorded video was... a cruel and cold character. She seemed to be friendly to the witch Helluram.'
-Lord, no! Brother. It won't work. I'll go meet that witch in the Black Sea. Lokia said so, she said that if it's a witch, she might have some way. To prevent Gipl's historical manipulation....
The words Sarah Runcandel had said in the recorded video of the third tomb.
When the war was raging a thousand years ago, and the history of the fairy tribe and Runcandel was being manipulated, Sarah wanted to meet Helluram after hearing Lokia's opinion.
Of course, it was not a problem to be rash. Jin didn't know what happened a thousand years ago.
Most of all, Qwaul was just a descendant of Lokia, not one of the knights of Runcandel.
"I need to find and meet this person Qwaul Ganesto. I can't know his location just from the records left in the blueprint and the mechanical device, right?"
"Yes. The year of part manufacturing is 1780. The year you were born."
The blueprint was made in 1775, and the teleportation device was made in 1780.
Although he said he needed to meet him, practically, meeting Qwaul was nearly impossible.
There was no way Gipl would neglect a magic engineer of such a level. Undoubtedly, Qwaul was the best magic engineer at the current time.
'My mother said she heard from the prophet that this machine would change the course of the war.'
Now that the machine has been revealed to be part of the teleportation device, the prophet's words were correct.
'Also, the prophet told my mother that she could supplement and strengthen the spaceship blueprint and start producing fleets immediately….'
"Then the prophet may also have the ability to complete the machine.
Considering efficiency alone, it would be better to contact the prophet immediately, hear detailed stories about him, and negotiate.
In fact, Rosa intended to do so.
- Originally, I planned to use them through the prophet.
- But I changed my mind when Joshua's rider qualification was suspended this time. I will postpone negotiations with the prophet. In the meantime, prove that you have a better way than the prophet.
Rosa didn't tell when that period specifically was. But Jin guessed that it would have been longer than Rosa's original plan due to the Glick subjugation war.
Currently, Rosa was overwhelmed just by organizing the family.
Many knights of the family died in the war. They lost more than 300 elite knights, including five Black Knights.
Runcandel has always put a black helmet on the top executors whenever a black knight was dispatched or died.

However, now it has reached its limit to maintain the 10-person system of Black Knights in this way. Mon, who had been demoted to an executioner after the Sota desert, was restored to the Black Knight.
'Mother will also have to be cautious because of the erosion of chaos.'

If only the power of the family was lost, Rosa is more likely to bring forward negotiations with the prophet. That way, they can quickly recover their strength and move forward while Zipple is weakened.
But now she was in a situation where she couldn't fully exert her strength, so she had to postpone the negotiation. It's currently difficult to negotiate with the prophet under proper conditions.
"Production may have started in earnest since then, but it must have been recent that technology has been developed to the point of being used in actual battle."

"Regardless of when it was possible to use, Zipple originally wanted to reveal the fleet and teleportation device later. Using the fleet as bait in the Sota desert was to confirm the existence of a prophet in your family."
Valeria returned the blueprints and machine to Jin. He tried several times to gain new information with record magic, but there was no further income.
"I really have to go now. Whatever, if there is any additional progress, send a letter to Tikan. Maybe soon your sister will be able to find a small clue about the fifth tomb of Temar."
"Luntia's sister? Somehow, I heard that Diphus Hyung, not Luntia's sister, was in charge of stopping the chaos. She was looking for Temar's tomb. It's surprising that it could help you."
"There might have been information you didn't know inside Runcandel. The third generation is moving based on that."
Valeria asked Jin for a handshake.
"See you again."
"Take care of yourself."
Two days later, in a completely unexpected place.
Jin was able to find a clue about Qwaul Ganesto.
"Was the alias of the man named Qwaul Ganesto Tinggen Bower?"
A maze within a maze.
Tallaris, with her pale face, asked with wide eyes as soon as she heard that name from Jin.
"Do you know him?"
"Neither Qwaul Ganesto nor Tinggen Bower are common names. Especially if Tinggen Bower is a magical engineer... I'm sure he's someone I know."
- A genius magical engineer, huh... There were a few among those I dated. Shall I contact him? Son-in-law.
Right after acquiring the mechanical device, Jin had talked with Tallaris about the need for an engineer.
And amazingly, Tallaris had once dated a person named Tinggen Bower in her youth.

"He was my 177th lover. Huh, I remember him very clearly because he was a lucky number and his unique personality. He was a man who was a sample of the expression 'genius is weird', and he made this in Zipple?"
"Huh, Tallaris. Do you have a way to contact him now?"
"I remember the house where he used to live, but the chances of him still living there are low, right? A log house in the hinterlands of the Phaelin Kingdom, it's been over 30 years."
"I still think it's good to go once. What kind of person was he?"
A smile passed over Tallaris' lips as she recalled her memories with Qwaul.
In the moment when it seemed like her memories with him weren't that bad, Tallaris grimaced.
"He was an unlucky bastard. I didn't think there would be another person in the world who could hurt me, except for your father!"
"... Excuse me? Did you say my father?"

"Oh, you might misunderstand. What I meant by your father hurting me was not about dating, but a duel. Anyway, Tinggen broke up with me because he was busy with some research, and I haven't heard from him since. Anyway, when my daughter comes back later, I'll give you the motte, so go check out the house where he used to live."
"I understand."
Vooooong-!
As soon as he answered, the motte appeared in front of Tallaris with a howl.
There were still spots of chaos black on various parts of the Mort's body. However, unlike Jin and other infectees, the Mort was slowly purifying the chaos with its own energy.
"Anyway, our daughter can't be a gentleman."
"Mother."
This was the first time he had met Syris after the war.
"Miss Syris."
Jin thought she would be angry at him because Tallaris had lost most of her strength, fallen into serious internal damage, and it seemed like it was not without his responsibility.
"Jin."
However, contrary to Jin's expectations, Syris did not show anger toward him. Instead, she seemed worried about him as she looked at the remaining spots on the back of his hand.
"…Are you okay?"
"Uh, yes. I'm still fine."
For a while, Syris silently stared at the back of Jin's hand. Jin felt awkward in the situation and coughed.
Syris would often get angry when Tallaris got involved in Runcandel and Zipple-related incidents because of Jin and suffered losses.
But she wasn't angry at Jin, but rather disliked the fact that the massive forces were looking down on the Maze.
She had long recognized Jin as her colleague. Her prickly behavior due to a peculiar rivalry with him was only temporary.
In particular, the Glexian subjugation was a task that Tallaris had to undertake to fulfill the Maze's mission, even if it wasn't because of Jin.

So Syris understood that it was thanks to Jin that the Maze had only suffered this much damage. She had heard that if Jin hadn't been there for Tallaris, she would have had to break all of Elona's seals.
If Elona had been freed from the seal, the Maze would have had to be cut off from the world for a long time until she disappeared.
And Jin's help didn't end there.
Syris's gaze reached behind Tallaris. She saw the sealed Elona Zipple with a mixture of energy.
Black Dragon Misha.
At Tallaris's request, she had come here immediately after the subjugation was over and was helping maintain the seal.
Since Elona could be released at any moment, Misha had poured all her strength into the seal without recovering at all.
As a result, Misha was now virtually in a coma, tied up with Elona's seal.
Jin also looked at Elona's seal and Misha, following Syris's gaze. It was natural to feel sorry for Misha, who had told Jin she was okay before entering the seal.
"Thank you for your concern, Miss Syris."
"I'm sorry I couldn't help."
"Huh, you two have a good atmosphere. Daughter, go on a date with your son-in-law right now. To the Phaelin Kingdom."
When Jin explained about Qwaul, Syris nodded her head willingly.
